meaning.vi: (người) 1902-68; Tiểu thuyết gia và nhà văn viết truyện ngắn Hoa Kỳ.

sentences.en: I always couple Hemingway and Steinbeck together as being typically American writers.

Bạn đã đọc Steinbeck nào chưa?

sentences.en: John Steinbeck famously described this zone as "ferociouswith life."

sentences.en: The Grapes of Wrath was written by John Steinbeck.

sentences.en: During the 1950's, Steinbeck continued to write.

sentences.en: It made the name of Steinbeck known throughtout America.
